claim: In the AWS Prescriptive Guidance comparison of microservice endpoints, Application Load Balancer rate limiting is through AWS WAF rate-based rules per client IP, while API Gateway offers AWS WAF rate-based rules and also throttling and quotas by using API keys and usage plans; Lambda function URLs rely on AWS Lambda concurrency limits.
question: Which endpoint option can throttle clients with API keys and usage plans: Application Load Balancer, API Gateway or Lambda function URLs?

values.display: by using API keys and usage plans

qualifiers.scope: AWS Prescriptive Guidance comparison of Application Load Balancer, API Gateway and Lambda function URLs as microservice endpoints
